Bob spent years working on his beloved 1969 K20 Truck, but he needs FantomWorks to solve the mysteries within. Dan’s brother-in-law John shows up with a 1962 Ferrari kit car that looks hot, but the wiring could burn it to the ground.
The 48 Dodge 4 door coupe are ready for the airbags to be installed. The 66 Corvette has a custom frame that is unique to Muscle Cars of Texas.

Sung's dive into the world's car cultures takes him to Poland, a country that emerged from a repressive communist era. Sung finds that new freedoms have led to an explosion of optimist and energy, and one of the most exciting experiences of his life.

Tom asks Dan to find him a rare 1967 Camaro Convertible with factory AC. But when Dan finds the Unicorn, the car is too good to cut up. Dave wants Dan to build a safe, all stock 1971 Datsun, but the car has been badly damaged by previous restoration work.

Brothers Jacob and Paul’s 1965 Chevy Impala nicknamed the Night Prowler would have been better named the Night Slug. Don shows up with a 1967 Corvette and a massive list of work that he wants done. Dan doesn’t know which is worse: the list, or the car.

programmes.t: Graveyard Carz: The Phantom 'Cuda Rides Again
programmes.d: The world is littered with the remains of forgotten muscle cars. At Graveyard Carz, some will get a second chance in the hands of Mark Worman and the Ghouls.

Ian wants a 1956 ‘baby bird’ restomod that drives like a sports car. Dan’s solution – a GTO-Thunderbird combo that drives like a bat out of hell. Doc Pellerin’s 1937 Volvo was a regular winner at Concours car shows – until a shelf fell on the car…
We go all-in on a massive power build, doubling the Mustang's horsepower in one epic session!

Robby wants to convert a 1926 Ford Model T to a far rarer 1914 C Cab. Dan agrees to the plan, but soon has cause to regret it. Anthony buys a 69 Chevrolet Camaro Convertible, but the car of his dreams is an accident waiting to happen.

Nick challenges Dan to build a 1969 Camaro Pace Car that can beat the fastest Chevelle that FantomWorks has ever built. Pete’s Mustang Convertible was in three different shops, but it arrives with far more problems than anyone was expecting.

Sung braves the ice-cold winter and reputation as one of the US's crime capitals to uncover the best of Chicago's car culture. He finds there's much more to the windy city than the Blues Mobile. Car nuts are giving the big city a small town heart.

programmes.d: The team tears down and works to get a long-neglected Nissan S14 running.
A single small part threatens to destroy a $10,000 engine build, find out if it the team can make it work.
A fully disassembled motorcycle is rebuilt from parts to determine if it can run again.

Japanese car culture holds a special place in Sung's heart. He's back exploring the home of drifting to see the coolest mods, and quirkiest characters. Sung finds that a quest for brilliance and excellence makes this the best place to get inspired.
Vinnie and the team are looking at a custom LS3 motor . The 1960 Corvette is getting work done on its brake pads.

Gary wants to restore a 1964 Mercedes 230SL, but his tight budget launches Dan into a headlong battle with a 50-year-old interior and a shattered cam shaft. Al wants to restore his father’s GTO, but FantomWorks discover it’s not the car Al thinks it is.

Dan and the team take on the restorations of a 1965 Cadillac Deville and a 1984 Monte Carlo. The 'caddie' is so full of leaves and rat droppings that it's a health hazard. The Monte Carlo is intended as an anniversary present.
This time, on Muscle Cars of Texas, Vinnie and the team are working on a 63 Z06, 59 Ford Pickup and a 69 Chevy Malibu.
Værterne oplever det stærke fællesskab i motorcykelkulturen gennem træf, events og fælles køreture.
Dropping $2500 in mods on a $3000 Mustang, but something goes seriously wrong along the way.
The Darnell's celebrate their return home by blowing off some pent-up explosive redneck frustration while Brooke tries to keep something very special under wraps.
Vinnie and the team are getting the sound system ready inside the 1969 Mustang Malicious Intent. The 1950 Ford has miles of wiring to install.

Dennis has always dreamed of owning the bright orange 1970 Shelby GT500 that kicked his ass in a drag race. Returning customer Rikk wants to get his rare 1970 Chrysler 300 Hurst in shape. But the car is plagued by a mystifying list of gremlins.

Kolin asks Dan to repair his smashed up 1973 Corvette, but Dan finds major problems that existed before the accident. Jim wants Dan to build him an asphalt crushing 1970 Challenger convertible by adding a 426 Hemi with all the fixin’s.
Full budget Mustang engine rebuild from scratch! Tearing down the blown motor and putting it back together.

Arthur bought his Cyclone new in 1967. Then, his father put 400,000 miles on it. Now, he wants FantomWorks to make it better than new. Antonio and his cousin Andres challenge Dan to build the fastest Mustang CS in Mexico.
The untold story of Ford's most mass-produced engine. Why 20 million were built and what made it unstoppable.

A salvaged Yamaha R1M is upgraded with performance parts and tested on a dyno.

FantomWorks finish the build of the ultimate Mustang Sleeper, a California Special powered by a Coyote Aluminator. Phil wants a 1949 Chevy Pick-up, but the truck is a disassembled jigsaw puzzle with a lot of pieces missing.
